description: SEC subsidiaries list (Exhibit 21) — List a public company's subsidiaries from the Exhibit 21 of its latest SEC 10-K (or Exhibit 8 of a 20-F): entity names, jurisdictions, country counts, US vs non-US, offshore financial center flags and ownership % when given. For KYB, due diligence and corporate mapping. ticker= or cik= or company=; optional q= name filter, limit= (default 200), filing=1..5 for older annual reports. Example: /v1/sec/subsidiaries?ticker=KO Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
